price.quote: The $1,799 MSRP Trax LT iQ builds on Troxus' Trax LT platform.

cls.basis: Class 1/2/3; ships at 20 mph with throttle = Class 2

spd.quote: Max Speed	Max Speed Up To 20 MPH on Throttle / Up To 28 MPH on Pedal Assist

tq.quote: Motor	Jiabo® 48V 500w+ Peak Power Hub-Drive Motor, 50Nm. Peak Torque
The bike has a Jiabo 500W Hub-Drive motor providing a maximum of 50Nm Torque.

wh.quote: Battery	UL-2271 Certified / Internal / Removable / Lithium Ion, 48V/10Ah (480Wh) with Samsung® Cells
It comes with a 48V / 10Ah (480Wh) battery with Samsung Cells (w/ Optional 240Wh Piggy-Back Battery).

range.quote: Range	Up To 55 Miles Per Charge/ Up to 80+ Miles w/Extra Battery

motor.quote: Rear Hub	Jiabo® 48V 500W/ 20 MPH, 50Nm. Peak Torque
The bike has a Jiabo 500W Hub-Drive motor providing a maximum of 50Nm Torque.

fold.quote: Frame	Hydroformed Aluminum Step-Thru Lightweight Frame
It has 30 Lux Front Light and Rear Light, a hydroformed aluminum frame, Zoom 65mm suspension fork, Tektro hydraulic brakes, Shimano Altus 8-speed drivetain and Kenda Kwick Seven 27.5x2.2-inch tires.

notes: Maker page says 'Class 1/2/3 eBike As Sold' with 20 mph max speed; spec table says pedal assist up to 28 mph, so cls 2, spd 20 adjustable to 28. Maker gives no rider height range. Only independent source found is a Bicycle Retailer news item (via one WebSearch); EBR/EBReport/N+1/Best Buy had no LT iQ, Northbound Outfitters dealer page was behind a Cloudflare bot check.
